units.name: Department of Management and Marketing
units.evidence: Official faculty page identifies department chair and Supply Chain Management professor/Longwood Logistics Center director. Official management page houses supply chain minor covering production, inventory, logistics and operations management.

decisions.reason: Official faculty page verifies this separate accounting/economics/finance/IS department. Operations and supply-chain curriculum appears on Management page; imported IS-bearing department not retained as operations unit.

sources.note: Two department chairs and SCM/logistics faculty.
Management curricular unit explicitly includes supply chain minor and operations scope.
University academic index reviewed, no named industrial engineering department; computer engineering services is administrative.

limitations: Department remit supported by management curriculum and college faculty listing; no standalone Operations department asserted.
